questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解：令}y'=p\text{，则}y''=\frac{dp}{dx}\text{，于是有}p'=\frac{2xp-p^2}{x^2}\text{，即}p'-\frac{2p}{x}=-\frac{p^2}{x^2}\text{，这是Bernoulli方程。令}\\&z=p^{1-2}=p^{-1}\text{，则上述方程化为}\frac{dz}{dx}+\frac{2}{x}z=\frac{1}{x^2}\text{。所以}z=e^{\int_{-2}^{-2}dx\left(\int_{-2}^{-2}e^{\int_{x}^{2}dx}dx+C_1\right)}=\frac{1}{x^2}(x+C_1)\text{，即}\\&p^{-1}=\frac{1}{x^2}(x+C_1)\text{，也就是}\frac{dx}{dy}=\frac{1}{x^2}(x+C_1)\text{，分离变量并积分得原方程的通解为}\\&y=\frac{1}{2}x^2-C_1x+C_1^2\ln|x+C_1|+C_2\text{。}\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答将该方程重新分项组合，得到}\left[(1+2yy')y''+(x+y^2)y''\right]+[2(y')^3+4yy'y']+2y''=0\text{即}\\&\left[(x+y^2)y''+2y(y')^2+2y'\right]=0\text{，积分得}\left(x+y^2\right)y''+2y(y')^2+2y'=C_1\text{，将上式写为}\\&\left[(x+y^2)y''+(1+2yy')y'\right]+y'=C_1\text{，两边积分，得}\left(x+y^2\right)y'+y=C_1x+C_2\text{，用3乘上式两端，得}\\&3(x+y^2)y'+3y=3C_1x+3C_2\text{，经整理得}\left(3xy\right)+\left(y^3\right)'=3C_1x+3C_2\text{，两边积分得通解}\\&\\&\text{第84页共149页}\\&\\&\\&3xy+y^3=\frac{3}{2}C_1x^2+3C_2x+C_3\text{。}\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答　将方程化为}\frac{y''}{y'-1}+\frac{x^2-1}{x}=0\text{，令}y'=z\text{，则上式化为}\left[\ln(z-1)\right]'=\frac{-x^2+1}{x}\text{，两边积分得}\\&\ln(z-1)=\ln|x|-\frac{x^2}{2}+C\text{，因此，}y'=C_1xe^{-\frac{x^2}{2}}+1\text{，再积分一次得通解}y=-C_1e^{-\frac{x^2}{2}}+x+C_2\text{。}\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解：令 }y'=p,\text{ 则有 }p'+2xp^2=0,\text{ 解得 }\frac{1}{p}=x^2+C_1,\text{ 由 }y'\bigg|_{x=0}=-\frac{1}{2}\text{ 得 }C_1=-2,\text{ 所以 }p=\frac{1}{x^2-2},\text{ 即}\\&\frac{dy}{dx}=\frac{1}{2\sqrt{2}}\left(\frac{1}{x-\sqrt{2}}-\frac{1}{x+\sqrt{2}}\right),\text{ 解得 }y=\frac{1}{2\sqrt{2}}\ln\left|\frac{x-\sqrt{2}}{x+\sqrt{2}}\right|+C_2,\text{ 由 }y'\bigg|_{x=0}=1,\text{ 得 }C_2=1,\text{ 所以，所求特}\\&\text{解为 }y=\frac{1}{2\sqrt{2}}\ln\left|\frac{x-\sqrt{2}}{x+\sqrt{2}}\right|+1。\end{aligned}
